ideas.pitch: An interactive voice-based health advisory system that translates government health announcements into authentic regional dialects of Eastern India using advanced voice cloning and synthesis.
ideas.title: VoiceVeda: Regional Dialect Localizer for Public Health
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the Best Project Built with ElevenLabs sponsor track, leveraging state-of-the-art voice AI for a localized social impact use case.

ideas.pitch: An n8n-powered automated pipeline that fetches local agricultural commodity prices, generates script summaries, and uses ElevenLabs to convert them into engaging voice broadcasts for local farmers.
ideas.title: AgroVox: Automated Multilingual Mandi Price Broadcaster
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines two major hackathon sponsor tools—ElevenLabs for audio generation and n8n for workflow automation—making it a dual-sponsor powerhouse.

ideas.pitch: A decentralized student club and project discovery hub deployed on a custom .xyz domain, featuring instant audio introductions of project leads generated via ElevenLabs.
ideas.title: CampusNav: .xyz Domain-Powered Student Organization Directory
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with .xyz sponsor incentives while integrating multimedia elements that catch judges' attention in a live demo setting.

ideas.pitch: An automated workflow using n8n to process recorded classroom lectures, extract key concepts, and synthesize accessible audio digests using ElevenLabs for visually impaired students.
ideas.title: AutoLecture: Automated Accessibility Notes and Audio Summarizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a real-world campus problem for FIEM students while heavily utilizing the core workflow and audio sponsor tools provided at the hackathon.

ideas.pitch: A crowd-sourced urban hazard and water-logging reporting system for Kolkata that triggers automated emergency audio warnings via ElevenLabs when danger thresholds are crossed.
ideas.title: SafeRoute Kolkata: Community Hazard Mapping & Audio Alerts
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses hyper-local challenges specific to Kolkata during monsoon or urban transit, appealing strongly to local judges for the Grand Prize.
